open.thesis: Split out of the validator-drift thesis, which was closed today on its validator half. RUNBOOK.md KNOWN LIMITATIONS still reads 'seasonProj is assumed live, not proven ... if two snapshots days apart show identical numbers, it is a preseason artifact.' That is settled and settled the other way: chem-seasonproj-live-2026-09-21 proved the field recomputes after each slate by diffing two commits, 245 of 250 season projections changed. A run that follows the runbook literally here will under-trust a live field. The REAL limitation, observed again today, is different and narrower: seasonProj does not price AVAILABILITY. Josh Jacobs reads 167.6 on the commissioner's exempt list; Jaxson Dart reads 238.5 in IPADE and 256.2 in Chem with a possibly season-ending knee; meanwhile Pacheco, Tank Dell and Stribling are correctly zeroed, so the behaviour is inconsistent rather than frozen. || [review notes before the last two folded 2026-10-26T22:40:00Z; outcomes preserved in the closed list] || REVIEWED 2026-10-26T22:40:00Z (Monday 16:00 Mexico City refresh, 22:05Z snapshot): UNRESOLVED. Add Gadsden as a second startable TE: 0.0 on 3 targets in Week 3 (archive) against Loveland's 7.1, then dropped by the owner for Sadiq on 30 Sep. The written falsifier (Njoku/Kolar activated) never fired, so it was badly written; the outcome decides.
Don't re-claim Hockenson: archive Week 3 Hockenson 3.1 against the held Gadsden's 0.0. Lost on the outcome; the priority it protected was spent on Gordon a week later anyway.

Its own falsifier fired: Lamar Jackson is on Baltimore's Wednesday report, limited with a back issue (BaltimoreRavens.com 30 Sep; Minter: 'something small'). Never sent, so no points lost, but the clause was written to close it and it fired. Row removed from both briefs. Any re-offer after Week 4 is a new entry.

The owner then dropped Pineiro for Jason Myers at 14:38Z on 30 Sep, five days after adding him, and swapped the 49ers D/ST for the Ravens at 14:29Z.
